description.de: Prüft Next.js Website: Lint und Production Build — blockiert Release bei Build-Fehlern
description.en: Validates Next.js website: lint and production build — blocks release on build failures

config.label: Website lint und build
config.command:
cd /home/flo/Entwicklung/IdeaProjects/treasure_hunt_web

echo '=== npm run lint ==='
npm run lint 2>&1
LINT_EXIT=$?

echo ''
echo '=== npm run build ==='
npm run build 2>&1
BUILD_EXIT=$?

echo ''
echo '--- Web Build Gate Summary ---'
echo "Lint exit code: $LINT_EXIT"
echo "Build exit code: $BUILD_EXIT"

if [ $BUILD_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "gate_status: RED"
  echo "gate_category: web-build"
  echo "gate_description: Next.js Build fehlgeschlagen — Release blockiert"
  exit 1
elif [ $LINT_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "gate_status: YELLOW"
  echo "gate_category: web-build"
  echo "gate_description: Lint-Warnungen vorhanden — Build erfolgreich"
else
  echo "gate_status: GREEN"
  echo "gate_category: web-build"
  echo "gate_description: Website Build erfolgreich, kein Lint-Fehler"
fi
